column1: science|/ˈsaɪəns/|n.|科学；科学研究|基础|science|natural science::自然科学;science and technology::科学技术|Science helps us test ideas against evidence.::科学帮助我们用证据检验观点。|She developed an interest in natural science at school.::她在上学时对自然科学产生了兴趣。

scientific|/ˌsaɪənˈtɪfɪk/|adj.|科学的；符合科学方法的|基础|science|scientific research::科学研究;scientific evidence::科学证据|The claim needs support from scientific evidence.::这一说法需要科学证据的支持。|Scientific research often begins with a clear question.::科学研究往往从一个明确的问题开始。

research|/ˈriːsɜːrtʃ/|n.; v.|研究；调查|基础|scientific-reasoning|carry out research::开展研究;research into::对……的研究|The team carried out research into local water quality.::团队对当地水质开展了研究。|We need to research the problem before suggesting a solution.::提出解决办法之前，我们需要研究这个问题。

experiment|/ɪkˈsperɪmənt/|n.|实验；试验|基础|scientific-reasoning|conduct an experiment::做实验;a controlled experiment::对照实验|The students designed an experiment to test their idea.::学生们设计了一项实验来检验他们的想法。|A controlled experiment compares conditions while limiting other changes.::对照实验在限制其他变化的同时比较不同条件。

theory|/ˈθɪri/|n.|理论；学说；解释|基础|scientific-reasoning|in theory::理论上;a scientific theory::科学理论|The new evidence supports one part of the theory.::新证据支持了这一理论的一部分。|The method works in theory, but we must test it.::这个方法在理论上行得通，但我们必须进行测试。

method|/ˈmeθəd/|n.|方法；办法|基础|method|a research method::研究方法;a practical method::实用方法|We need a practical method for comparing the results.::我们需要一种比较结果的实用方法。|Different questions may require a different research method.::不同的问题可能需要不同的研究方法。

data|/ˈdeɪtə/|n.|数据；资料|基础|measurement|collect data::收集数据;data analysis::数据分析|The team collected data from three different locations.::团队从三个不同地点收集了数据。|Data analysis revealed a pattern that we had missed.::数据分析揭示了我们之前忽略的一个规律。

measure|/ˈmeʒər/|v.; n.|测量；评估；措施|基础|measure|measure the distance::测量距离;take measures::采取措施|Use this tool to measure the distance between the lines.::用这个工具测量两条线之间的距离。|The town took measures to reduce traffic near the school.::镇上采取了措施，减少学校附近的交通流量。

measurement|/ˈmeʒərmənt/|n.|测量；测得的数值|四级|measure|an accurate measurement::准确的测量;take measurements::进行测量|An accurate measurement requires careful use of the instrument.::准确的测量需要谨慎使用仪器。|We repeated the measurement to check for errors.::我们重复了测量，以检查是否存在错误。

accurate|/ˈækjərət/|adj.|准确的；精确的|四级|accurate|accurate information::准确信息;an accurate description::准确的描述|We need accurate information before making a decision.::作出决定之前，我们需要准确的信息。|The map gives an accurate description of the area.::这张地图准确地呈现了这一地区的情况。

accuracy|/ˈækjərəsi/|n.|准确性；精确程度|基础|accurate|check the accuracy::核查准确性;improve accuracy::提高准确性|Please check the accuracy of all names and dates.::请核查所有姓名和日期的准确性。|Better tools can improve the accuracy of the measurements.::更好的工具可以提高测量的准确性。

hypothesis|/haɪˈpɑːθəsɪs/|n.|假说；有待检验的解释|六级|scientific-reasoning|test a hypothesis::检验假说;a working hypothesis::工作假说|The experiment was designed to test a specific hypothesis.::这项实验旨在检验一个具体假说。|A useful hypothesis makes predictions that can be checked.::有用的假说能够作出可验证的预测。

empirical|/ɪmˈpɪrɪkəl/|adj.|以观察或实验为依据的；经验性的|六级|empirical|empirical evidence::实证证据;empirical research::实证研究|The argument needs more empirical evidence to support it.::这一论点需要更多实证证据来支持。|Empirical research may reveal limits in a popular theory.::实证研究可能揭示一种流行理论的局限。

empirically|/ɪmˈpɪrɪkli/|adv.|通过观察或实验；以实证方式|扩展|empirical|empirically tested::经过实证检验的;empirically supported::得到实证支持的|The proposed relationship has not yet been tested empirically.::所提出的关系尚未经过实证检验。|We compared the models empirically using the same data.::我们使用同一组数据，通过实证方式比较了这些模型。

objective|/əbˈdʒektɪv/|adj.; n.|客观的；目标|四级|scientific-reasoning|an objective assessment::客观评估;a clear objective::明确目标|We need an objective assessment of both proposals.::我们需要对两项提案进行客观评估。|The main objective is to reduce the number of errors.::主要目标是减少错误数量。

subjective|/səbˈdʒektɪv/|adj.|主观的；受个人感受影响的|基础|scientific-reasoning|a subjective judgment::主观判断;subjective experience::主观体验|Taste is subjective, so people may prefer different designs.::审美是主观的，因此人们可能偏好不同的设计。|The survey includes questions about subjective experience.::这项调查包含有关主观体验的问题。

quantitative|/ˈkwɑːntəteɪtɪv/|adj.|数量的；定量的|四级|measurement|quantitative analysis::定量分析;quantitative data::定量数据|The report combines quantitative data with personal accounts.::报告将定量数据与个人叙述结合起来。|Quantitative analysis can help compare the scale of changes.::定量分析有助于比较变化的幅度。

qualitative|/ˈkwɑːləteɪtɪv/|adj.|性质的；定性的|四级|measurement|qualitative research::定性研究;a qualitative difference::质的差别|The interviews provided material for qualitative research.::这些访谈为定性研究提供了材料。|There is a qualitative difference between the two approaches.::这两种方法之间存在质的差别。

variable|/ˈveriəbəl/|n.; adj.|变量；可变的|四级|vary|a key variable::关键变量;variable costs::可变成本|Temperature was the only variable changed during the test.::温度是测试期间唯一被改变的变量。|The journey time is variable because traffic conditions change.::由于交通状况会变化，行程时间并不固定。

variation|/ˌveriˈeɪʃən/|n.|变化；差异；变体|四级|vary|seasonal variation::季节性变化;variation in::……方面的差异|The data show a large variation in daily demand.::数据显示每日需求存在很大差异。|The study accounts for seasonal variation in temperature.::这项研究考虑了气温的季节性变化。

correlate|/ˈkɔːrəleɪt/|v.|相关；使相互关联|六级|correlate|correlate with::与……相关;correlate two variables::关联两个变量|The researchers examined whether the two measures correlate.::研究人员考察了这两个测量指标是否相关。|Higher scores may correlate with more practice, but not always.::更高的分数可能与更多练习相关，但并非总是如此。

correlation|/ˌkɔːrəˈleɪʃən/|n.|相关性；相互关系|六级|correlate|a strong correlation::高度相关;correlation between::……之间的相关性|The study found a correlation between the two variables.::这项研究发现了两个变量之间的相关性。|A correlation alone does not establish a causal relationship.::仅有相关性并不能确立因果关系。

causal|/ˈkɔːzəl/|adj.|原因的；因果关系的|扩展|cause|a causal link::因果联系;a causal explanation::因果解释|The team looked for a causal explanation of the pattern.::团队试图对这一规律作出因果解释。|More evidence is needed to support a causal link.::需要更多证据来支持因果联系。

causality|/kɔːˈzæləti/|n.|因果关系；因果性|扩展|cause|establish causality::确立因果关系;the direction of causality::因果关系的方向|The experiment was intended to investigate causality.::这项实验旨在研究因果关系。|Observational data may leave the direction of causality unclear.::观察性数据可能无法明确因果关系的方向。

verify|/ˈverɪfaɪ/|v.|核实；验证|四级|verify|verify a claim::核实说法;verify the identity::核实身份|Please verify the figures before publishing the report.::发布报告前，请核实这些数字。|A second experiment can help verify the original result.::第二次实验可以帮助验证最初的结果。

verification|/ˌverɪfɪˈkeɪʃən/|n.|核实；验证过程|四级|verify|independent verification::独立核验;identity verification::身份核验|The result still requires independent verification.::这一结果仍需独立核验。|The system sends a message for identity verification.::系统会发送一条消息以进行身份核验。

replicate|/ˈreplɪkeɪt/|v.|重复进行；复制；重现|扩展|replicate|replicate an experiment::重复实验;replicate a result::重现结果|Another team tried to replicate the experiment.::另一个团队尝试重复这项实验。|The finding is more convincing when others can replicate it.::当其他人能够重现这一发现时，它会更有说服力。

replication|/ˌreplɪˈkeɪʃən/|n.|重复实验；复制；重现|扩展|replicate|independent replication::独立重复实验;successful replication::成功重现|Independent replication helps researchers assess a finding.::独立重复实验帮助研究人员评估一项发现。|The paper describes a successful replication of the earlier study.::这篇论文描述了对先前研究的一次成功重现。

phenomenon|/fəˈnɑːmɪnɑːn/|n.|现象；引人注目的事物|基础|scientific-reasoning|a natural phenomenon::自然现象;a common phenomenon::常见现象|The northern lights are a natural phenomenon.::极光是一种自然现象。|The study offers an explanation for this common phenomenon.::这项研究对这一常见现象提出了解释。

methodology|/ˌmeθəˈdɑːlədʒi/|n.|方法论；一套研究方法|四级|method|research methodology::研究方法论;a clear methodology::清晰的方法体系|The paper explains the methodology used to select participants.::论文解释了选择参与者所用的方法。|A clear methodology makes the research easier to evaluate.::清晰的方法体系使研究更容易评估。
